title: Insects
description: Insects are not mindless, but they are far more willing to sacrifice themselves for the good of a greater hive or colony.
inPlay: Insects reward crews that think about the colony rather than the individual creature. Cutting off a nest, disrupting a trail, or removing a lure is often more effective than simply killing whatever is in front of them.

hazards.name: Bizarre Hybrid Ship-Chasers
hazards.summary: An uncanny blend of praying mantis and dragonfly - aggressive hunters confident and hungry enough to ambush and tackle ships.

hazards.name: Legs, Teeth & Chitinous Scales
hazards.summary: Snapperpillars: fierce territorial creatures somewhere between crocodile and giant centipede, lairing in risen ruins.

hazards.name: Sly Arachnid Hunters
hazards.summary: Ambush scorpions: sometimes as large as a trading vessel, lone predators that dwell in the thickest parts of the tangle.

hazards.name: Swift Vessels of Spreading Slime
hazards.summary: Manta slugs: dog-sized slugs with wide, manta ray-like front sections that 'swim' in fast-exuded slime, scaling walls and ceilings alike.

hazards.name: Fungal Insect
hazards.summary: Rotipedes: large, many-legged arthropods in symbiosis with fungus on their bodies, able to consume almost anything between the two hungers.

hazards.name: Slipwise Spectralities
hazards.summary: A voracious insect capable of jaunting between the material and spectral realms; dangerous, but often hunted for what it can do.

hazards.name: Freezing Insect Gardeners
hazards.summary: Insects that build constructions of hardened nectar and bring the true sting of winter to the warmer reaches of the waves.
